page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9i.3xlarge is a general-purpose instance deployed on KVM hypervisor infrastructure. It operates on the x86_64 architecture and is powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor running at a base clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The hardware configuration provides 12 dedicated virtual CPU cores paired with 48.0 GB of memory, establishing a standard 1:4 ratio with 4.0 GB of RAM allocated per core. Dedicated vCPU provisioning ensures predictable computation without multi-tenant host CPU oversubscription.

The server does not include local disk storage, requiring external cloud block storage volumes for persistent data and operating system installations. Networking infrastructure provides a baseline throughput of 10 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default. The system contains no hardware GPU accelerators, directing all computational operations to the central processor.

With balanced CPU compute capacity and proportional memory density, the ecs.g9i.3xlarge achieves consistent resource efficiency for workloads that do not demand high-throughput local disk storage. The instance configuration is well aligned with backend application tiers, container orchestration nodes, enterprise web applications, caching services, and intermediate database deployments requiring dedicated compute resources.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9i.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual server offering 12 dedicated vCPUs and 48.0 GB of memory on the x86_64 architecture. Driven by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor clocked at 3.2 GHz and virtualized through KVM, it maintains a balanced 1:4 CPU-to-memory proportion with 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance does not include integrated local storage, directing all data persistence to attached network block devices, and provides a network baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps without bundled public IPv4 addresses or GPU acceleration. Dedicated processor allocation prevents resource contention, delivering predictable compute performance across system tasks. These architectural specifications make the instance appropriate for enterprise web serving, microservice hosting, data processing pipelines, and production application workloads requiring steady compute and memory capacity.
